item.text: The slide has two shapes: a title and one body text shape. I’m appending one concise bullet line to the body text and saving the active presentation through LibreOffice so the open document updates in place.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import uno, time
local_ctx=uno.getComponentContext(); smgr=local_ctx.ServiceManager
resolver=smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx)
ctx=resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
desktop=ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
for comp in desktop.Components:
    if getattr(comp, 'URL', '').endswith('/69_4.pptx'):
        doc=comp
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit('presentation not found')
page=doc.DrawPages.getByIndex(0)
body=page.getByIndex(1)
bullet='• Art reflects culture, history, and human expression.'
if bullet not in body.String:
    body.String = body.String.rstrip() + '\\n' + bullet
# ensure modified doc is persisted
try:
    doc.store()
except Exception as e:
    print('store failed:', type(e).__name__, e)
    raise
print(repr(body.String))
PY"
